description: Network connections are not terminated at the end of sessions or after periods of inactivity. This signal indicates that stale network connections may remain available for exploitation.
applicability: Applicable to all network sessions. Includes session timeout settings, connection lifecycle management, and inactive connection termination policies.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through network session configuration review, timeout policy verification, and connection lifecycle testing.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
